subtitle: A hot Lavazza espresso with steamed milk, airy foam and chocolate powder, suited to drinkers who enjoy a creamy coffee.
quickAnswer: The Wetherspoons Lavazza Cappuccino typically costs {price}, contains {calories} kcal and comes with Lavazza espresso, steamed milk, a thick milk foam topping and a light dusting of chocolate powder. taste:
This cappuccino combines a robust espresso flavour with the softer sweetness of steamed milk. The Lavazza coffee provides the deep, complex base, while the milk makes the drink creamy rather than solely coffee-led. A light dusting of chocolate powder adds gentle sweetness at the surface without changing the espresso and milk combination at its centre.

Texture is a key part of the appeal: velvety steamed milk sits beneath a thick, airy cap of foam. That contrast gives you both creaminess and a lighter topping. Served steaming hot, it suits a mid-morning pause or a coffee after a larger meal, especially alongside a mini chocolate brownie.

Lavazza Cappuccino is listed as vegetarian, and milk is the allergen recorded in our data. The steamed milk and milk foam mean the drink as described is not suitable for a vegan diet. Anyone with a milk allergy should take particular care before ordering.

The listed allergen is not a complete assurance about preparation or cross-contact. Ask the pub for its current [allergen information](/allergen-information) and discuss any dietary requirements with staff. Swaps can change both ingredients and allergens, so do not assume an altered version has the same dietary profile.
